sync.headline: Today (Fri 11/13) bonuses have to be submitted for the 11/15 payout, and your new weekly call with Andy and Paul starts at 2:00 with nothing on its agenda yet. Sunday 11/15 carries three things at once — the supply-vs-demand dashboard and zones 1–2 of Jan–Mar to Andy, and your visit to the Rec session at Pier 40 — and Wednesday 11/18 is Media Day at Socceroof with Kyle away, on the same day as Soccer For All (noon), the Paychex underwriting-decision call (12:30, overlapping) and Ops Weekly. Moving: the 9/30 reconciliation (the receivable still has to be built) and healthcare; the audit draft is expected Monday. Stuck or slipping: the Jan–March winter schedule announcement waits on final spaces (LREI with Mal, Immaculate Conception with you — Playbook demo 11/23), the COI renewal is due before 11/24, and three of your cards are past their dates — Kyle's Decision & Ownership Guide (11/10), the parent FAQ and the Select Teams invite (both 11/11). No meeting notes changed in Drive since yesterday.

themes.name: Finance reset
themes.text: The catch-ups with Andy have become a standing Friday 2:00 call with Andy and Paul, starting today, which is also the day bonuses go in for the 11/15 payout (Kristen, Noemi, Nirmala). The next moves are KP's — check Nirmala's formulas and links and build the 9/30 receivable, and get the audit timetable ahead of the draft expected around 11/16 for the Dec 8 board meeting; the finance-hire search and the Sept/Oct expense catch-up still need owners.

themes.name: Payroll & healthcare
themes.text: The 11/10 rule that no full-time employee is paid hourly — the bonus plan covers extra time — still has to be written into the handbook and communicated to the community-programming staff it affects, and neither step has an owner. Paul runs healthcare: Paychex presents the underwriting decision Wed 11/18 at 12:30, then plan selection and open enrollment for Jan 1.
